name: A Couple Buys A Horse
source:
For as long as she could remember, even pre-memory as she likes to think, Melenum (22) wanted to be a horse. Lucky for her she lives in a province where that not only is a possibility but a noble and respectable goal.

But, it also is a tough career choice...

Even for Melenum, who is really into the culture, it still takes her four years before she finishes with all the requirements, the pre-training, the contract signing, the transformations and the full training program.

This story starts on the day she becomes a fully contracted horse, the property of Magdalene and Finn Park(46).

[From [url=https://atinylittlecloud.itch.io/a-couple-buys-a-horse]itch.io[/url]]
